name.value: West Coast Trail Information & Orientation Centre

description.value: The West Coast Trail Information & Orientation Centre is the Parks Canada gateway facility for registering and orienting hikers tackling the legendary 75-km West Coast Trail, one of Canada's most demanding multi-day backcountry routes along the remote west shore of Vancouver Island. The centre sits within Pacific Rim National Park Reserve in the traditional territories of the Huu-ay-aht, Ditidaht, and Pacheedaht First Nations, whose Guardians help maintain the trail. Touring cyclists riding the Vancouver Island coast pass through this isolated region and may find the facility a useful reference point, though it is primarily oriented toward backcountry hikers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Parks Canada registration and orientation facility for the 75-km West Coast Trail in Pacific Rim National Park Reserve; the site is live and references 2026 programming. However, the website content is entirely focused on trail hiking logistics and contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water access, or any other cycling-relevant amenities. No phone number or physical address appears in either OSM tags or the website content.
concerns: No physical address in OSM or on website
No phone number in OSM or on website
Website URL is the general WCT trail page, not a dedicated page for the physical orientation centre building — amenity details for the centre itself are unavailable
Facility is hiker-registration focused; cycling relevance is unconfirmed
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate active Parks Canada facility in a remote Vancouver Island cycling corridor, but the facility exists primarily to register and orient backcountry hikers — not cyclists — and no cycling-relevant amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) could be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact with Parks Canada is needed to determine cyclist utility.

wow_evidence: Parks Canada gateway facility for the WCT; gateway-VC ladder 2/2 — riders visit the trailhead of a legendary trail even if not hiking it.
